name: Slayers 2
creator: Ouw Productions
redeem: Join the Ouw Productions group on Roblox first, since some codes like Release26 need it.
Launch Slayers 2 and click the splash screen once it finishes loading.
On the main menu, click the enter a code box along the bottom of the screen.
Type the code exactly as shown and press Enter to claim it before you pick a slot and play.
notes:
Slayers 2 is a Demon Slayer inspired action RPG from Ouw Productions, the team behind Project Slayers. You make a character, roll for a clan, and then train as either a Demon Slayer who learns a Breathing style or a Demon who uses Evil Arts. You level up by fighting enemies and bosses, spend points in a skill tree, and team up with other players on quests across the map.

Codes usually give Spins, Wen and resets. Spins are the most useful because they let you reroll your clan or art for a stronger one, and a good roll shapes your whole build. Reset codes let you respec your Breathing, Evil Art or skill tree for free. New codes often come out with updates and after server shutdowns, and some only last about a day, so check the Discord often.

faq.q: Why does Release26 not work for me in Slayers 2?
faq.a: That code needs you to be in the Ouw Productions Roblox group. Join the group, rejoin the game, and try it again from the main menu.

faq.q: Should I use Slayers 2 Spins right away?
faq.a: Only if you are unhappy with your clan or art. If you already have a roll you like, save Spins for when a new clan or art is added in an update.
Yes. Type Release26 and SkillTreeReset with the same capital letters shown here, and redeem codes quickly because many expire within a day or two.

tips: Choose your path early. Slayers learn a Breathing style and climb the ranks from Mizunoto to Hashira, while Demons use Blood Demon Arts and rise toward Upper Moon.
Plan your skill tree before you spend points. Reset codes exist, but they can expire, so do not count on fixing a messy build later.
Bosses and raids are much harder than normal enemies. Team up with other players for them instead of going in alone.
On mobile, you can turn shift lock on in the top right corner and change your button size in settings. Mobile and console players can also adjust aim assist.
useRewards: ANIM4L, SPINS50 and Release26 give 130 Spins together, which is plenty of rerolls for a new character. Keep the Ores and the Refinement Ore until you know what you want to improve. Release26 also adds 100 Wen. Use the Breathing, Evil Art and skill tree reset codes only after you have tried a build and want to change it, since each code works once.
